name: Percona XtraBackup 8.0
description: Percona XtraBackup 8.0：MySQL 8.0 数据库热物理备份工具，支持全量与增量备份。

apt.command: DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y wget gnupg lsb-release && wget -qO - https://repo.percona.com/apt/percona-release_latest.generic_all.deb | DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive dpkg -i && percona-release enable-only ps-80 release && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y percona-xtrabackup-80

yum.command: yum install -y https://repo.percona.com/yum/percona-release-latest.noarch.rpm && percona-release enable-only ps-80 release && yum install -y percona-xtrabackup-80

post_install_tips: 将 xtrabackup 所在目录加入系统 PATH：export PATH=/opt/xtrabackup/bin:$PATH
